kind.description: Open XML object kind to list. Use parentRef to walk only the native structure needed for the direct operation.

scope.description: Exact story-part URI such as /word/document.xml. This is not a table nativePath or ancestor filter.

parentRef.description: Optional revision-bound parent object ref. Returns only its nearest published child objects; this is not recursive descendant search.

limit.description: Maximum identities in this small page. Follow continuation only when the same structural inventory is required; use docx_find_literal instead of paging through paragraphs for content.
